description.value: The Salty Caramel Kitchen is a fully plant-based bakery and cafe just off Okanagan Lake in Lake Country, serving breakfast, lunch, baked goods, and specialty coffees. Started in 2016 as a home-based vegan cake business, it opened its brick-and-mortar shop in 2018 and has built a loyal following for plant-based food that appeals well beyond the vegan crowd. The cafe's relaxed beach vibe and proximity to Pebble Beach make it a natural stop for cyclists on the Okanagan Centre road.

address.value: 11407 Okanagan Centre Road West, Lake Country, BC V4V 2J6
